title: Town of Port Hedland Economic Development & Diversification Fund Grant
description: We are proud to have been awarded $15,000 through the Town of Port Hedland's Economic Development & Diversification Fund to develop our Mighty Orchid Services Hedland Community Hub, a welcoming local space for connection, inclusion and community.

title: The Big Pitch Hedland Top 6 Finalist
description: We are proud to have been selected as a Top 6 finalist in The Big Pitch Hedland, presented by the Port Hedland Chamber of Commerce and Industry, recognising our vision for sustainable, community-focused initiatives in the Pilbara.

title: PHCCI Best Community Organisation Finalist
description: We are honoured to be a PHCCI 2026 finalist for Excellence in Customer Service, a recognition of our dedication to putting people first and providing the care, attention, and support our customers deserve.

title: KDCCI Best Community Organisation Nominee
description: We were proud to be nominated for the Community Impact Award at the KDCCI Business Excellence Awards, recognising the work we do to strengthen connection, care, and inclusion across the Karratha community.

title: PHCCI Bronze Sponsor
description: We are proud to support the PHCCI 2026 awards as a Bronze Sponsor, demonstrating our commitment to industry excellence and our dedication to fostering a thriving professional community.

title: PHCCI Rising Star Nominee
description: We are honoured to be a PHCCI 2026 Rising Star nominee, a recognition of our rapid growth, innovation, and the positive impact we are making within our industry.
